# [TASK] Tests and docs: bilingual voice control

## Task
Round out test coverage and update docs for bilingual voice control.

## Scope
Coverage gaps left after Tasks #1-#5's own inline tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Integration test exercises the full pipeline (language switch -> transcription -> intent parsing -> command dispatch) for both languages
- [x] `backend/ai-service/README.md`'s "Supported Voice Commands" section updated with German phrasing and the language switch
- [x] JaCoCo/Istanbul coverage for touched code meets the project threshold
- [x] `docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` updated if the language-parameterized model loading changed anything it currently describes

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
Closed against commit `b6aebb3`.

Backend tests chain `POST /speech-to-text` into `POST /voice-command` for English and German, asserting via `ArgumentCaptor<Prompt>` that the transcript really reaches the model. `VoiceControl.pipeline.test.jsx` drives the same path on the frontend with only `fetch` mocked.

README and ARCHITECTURE.md §3.7 updated for the endpoint, the EN/DE toggle and the two real Vosk models. Note: `/voice-command` requires a JWT — only `/speech-to-text` is public.

Still open under #200: #215 and #229.
